references.text: Jesus uses the metaphor of leaven to warn against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees, which is similar to the warning in Mark 8:15 against the leaven of the Pharisees and Herod.
Jesus warns the disciples about the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees, parallel to the warning in Mark 8:15.
The warning against the hypocrisy of the Pharisees, which can be seen as a form of 'leaven', has similarities with the warning in Mark 8:15.
